description: An envelope detector: it follows the amplitude of an audio signal and puts out a control voltage that traces it.

params.text: Sets the fall time of the envelope, 1ms to 2 seconds, starting at 500ms.
Sets the rise time of the envelope, 1ms to 250ms, starting at 20ms.
Chooses what the detector measures: peak, mean-square or root-mean-square.

inputs.text: The audio whose amplitude is followed; sixteen channels are followed separately.

outputs.text: The envelope traced from the input.

menu: Clamping — holds the envelope at a ceiling of 1 so that it cannot read higher.
Output type — chooses Linear or Logarithmic, the logarithmic reading being in dB.
